ruleSystem.vertical: k=0..15; full width; remove k total rows alternating top then bottom as evenly as possible
ruleSystem.horizontal: k=0..7; full height; remove k total columns alternating left then right as evenly as possible
ruleSystem.legSplit: split each opposite-corner Bresenham diagonal at its raster midpoint; odd paths share one midpoint pixel, even paths share the central two-pixel bridge
